newsitem.title: SPAIN: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO WANT REPLAY OF FINAL GAME OF 1993-94 SEASON.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DEPORTIVO WANT REPLAY OF FINAL GAME OF 1993-94 SEASON.

text.p: In an attempt to rewrite sporting history Deportivo Coruna are continuing with legal action to force a replay of the final game of the 1993-94 championship, which they lost on goal difference to Barcelona.
Deportivo chairman Augusto Lendoiro thinks a favourable decision could be worth billions of pesetas which participation in the lucrative Champions' League would have brought the club.
Deportivo have always maintained they should have played their game with Valencia the day after Barcelona faced Sevilla.

Instead Deportivo's game was brought forward, and while Barcelona were winning, defender Miroslav Djukic missed a penalty that would have given Deportivo their first league title in the final minute of an agonizing goalless draw.
"Barcelona had the right to play on Saturday, as they had to play the European Cup the following week, but we didn't. It was an unfair situtation," Lendoiro told Reuters on Thursday.
Lendoiro added that he didn't know how long the legal action could take. The case is currently in the highest regional court in Galicia, the area where Deportivo are based.
No official was available for comment at Spain's Professional Football League on Thursday, while Barcelona refused to comment on the case.
